# What’s the best AI copilot for contact center agents?


[Riah Lawry](https://www.liveperson.com/blog/author/rlawry/)


August 18, 2026 • 8 minutes


---


The best contact center copilot is one that improves measurable outcomes, like first contact resolution and CSAT, while fitting within the existing agent workflow with little to no disruption.


**Key takeaways:** The live agent workspace is an often-overlooked tech stack, but as AI agents take on routine conversations, live agents are handling[more complex, higher-value conversations](https://www.liveperson.com/blog/cx-growth-engine/) that require better AI assistance natively built into the agent workspace. Brands that support live agents with more advanced copilot capabilities are seeing higher CSAT and better first-contact resolutions rates.


---


## What makes an AI copilot for live agents a smart investment?


The human agent remains the moment that defines the customer relationship. When a conversation gets complex, emotional, or high value, a person is the one who resolves it, and the quality of that resolution shapes loyalty, retention, and brand perception.


That’s why the agent workspace matters so much. It’s where the agent reads context, drafts replies, checks knowledge, and moves a conversation toward resolution. When the workspace is cluttered or slow, agents spend their energy on manual work instead of on the customer. When the workspace is intelligent and streamlined, agents resolve issues faster and communicate with more clarity and empathy.


**A live agent AI copilot is designed to make that workspace work harder for the agent.** It handles the repetitive parts of the job, such as writing summaries and polishing wording so the agent can focus on judgment, tone, and problem-solving.


Here at LivePerson, we know the value of supporting live agents with AI assistance built into the agent workspace. Our[LivePerson AI Copilot](https://www.liveperson.com/products/copilot/) gives agents AI summarization and smart rewrite directly inside the Conversational Cloud Agent Workspace. Live agents are able to resolve conversations faster across non-native languages and with expanded skills.


**Takeaway:** The right agent copilot strengthens the human agent and delivers measurable outcomes for brands.

## How to evaluate AI copilots for the contact center


Evaluate an agent copilot on the business outcomes it moves. The five criteria below give buyers a clear, standardized way to compare options.


Evaluation criterion What to look for Why it matters


Average handle time (AHT) Does the copilot cut drafting and context-gathering time? Lower AHT means more capacity without added headcount.


First contact resolution (FCR) Does stronger context reduce back-and-forth? Higher FCR means fewer repeat contacts and lower cost to serve.


Customer satisfaction (CSAT) Do clearer, more empathetic responses lift sentiment? CSAT is a direct read on customer loyalty and retention.


Agent experience Does it reduce repetitive work? A better agent experience supports retention and quality.


Ease of adoption Does it fit the existing workflow with minimal training and IT lift? Fast adoption is what turns a feature into realized value.


LivePerson Copilot is built around these outcomes. It reduces handle time by streamlining drafting and eliminating manual context gathering. It supports higher first contact resolution by giving agents stronger context and precision. It improves CSAT through clearer and more empathetic responses. And it fits inside the existing agent workspace, so teams see gains quickly.


**Takeaway:** Evaluate an agent copilot on the outcomes it moves, and LivePerson Copilot is built to move the ones that matter.


## Why the LivePerson Agent Workspace stands out


LivePerson Copilot is purpose-built for enterprise customer service, and two capabilities show why the agent workspace stands out: AI Summarization and Smart Rewrite.


### AI Summarization captures context instantly


AI Summarization gives agents an AI-generated overview of an ongoing or past conversation, which removes the need to read a full transcript before responding.


AI Summarization gives agents an AI-generated overview of an ongoing or past conversation, which removes the need to read a full transcript before responding. In the LivePerson Agent Workspace, summaries generate automatically once a conversation reaches five or more messages, so no manual trigger is needed. That makes handoffs and transfers smoother, because the receiving agent starts with context instead of guesswork. Agents should still verify critical details, since a summary is a fast read rather than a substitute for the record.


### Smart Rewrite improves clarity while preserving voice


Smart Rewrite refines an agent’s staged response for grammar, clarity, professionalism, and brand-appropriate tone before it is sent.


It polishes the agent’s words rather than inventing new ones, so the message still sounds like the agent. This is especially valuable for teams communicating in a second language or working across outsourced partners, where consistency and tone can be difficult to maintain at scale.


### Built into the workspace agents already use


Both capabilities run inside the existing Conversational Cloud Agent Workspace. There are no additional tools to buy, no complex implementation, and no extensive retraining. Agents keep their workflow, and the AI meets them inside it.


Together, AI Summarization and Smart Rewrite improve productivity, consistency, and customer experience at the same time. They shorten the time it takes to understand a conversation and the time it takes to respond well, which shows up in higher CSAT, faster resolution, and reduced handle time.


> For enterprise contact centers, the value of a copilot comes down to outcomes. If it can reduce handle time, improve consistency, and fit naturally into the agent workflow, it becomes a real driver of customer experience and operational efficiency.
>
>
> Jim Hayes – Director of Solutions Consulting at LivePerson


**Takeaway:** LivePerson pairs strong AI with a low-friction rollout, which is what turns capability into realized value.


## Copilot customer success stories


The clearest proof of an agent copilot’s value is what happens after real teams adopt it. LivePerson customers have measured meaningful gains in production as brands rolled out Smart Rewrite, with efficiency improvements that grew alongside adoption.


- A retail brand **reduced conversation duration by 41% after adopting Smart Rewrite.**
- A travel brand **reduced conversation duration by 31% as adoption increased, while CSAT remained stable.**
- Across these deployments, per-conversation efficiency gains ranged from roughly 3 to 11 minutes.


The pattern is consistent: as more agents used Smart Rewrite, conversation duration fell, and customer satisfaction held steady rather than dropping. Faster does not have to mean worse. In these cases, agents resolved conversations more quickly without sacrificing the experience customers received.
